notes: IdentityToken mints 1,000,000,000 ID with 18 decimals once to msg.sender in its constructor. The zero feeRecipient argument selects msg.sender, which is the factory during this launch, to receive the 8% fee on ordinary transfers, rounded down and deducted from the transferred amount. Transfers involving the factory, pool manager, current fee recipient, or distributor resolved through factory.distributorOf(launchNumber) are fee-exempt. Only the current fee recipient can change the fee recipient. There are no additional application contracts or initialization calls. Native ETH is currency0 and ID is currency1; initialPrice records sqrt(totalSupply / initialMarketCapWei) * 2^96. This price is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the supplied economics and totalSupply.
